description: This file defines the RestXmlParser class, which implements REST-XML parsing logic for AWS services such as S3 and CloudFront. It extends AbstractRestParser and uses a payload parser trait to handle XML responses.

classes.name: RestXmlParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling REST-XML formatted responses from AWS services.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the parser with a service description and an optional XML parser.

methods.name: payload
methods.description: Parses the payload of an HTTP response using the specified structure shape and updates the result array.

methods.name: parseMemberFromStream
methods.description: Parses an XML member from a stream response, using the internal XML parser.
